content.title: Selfie Route Discovery | Local Taste Proof and Resumption
content.summary: Preserve one clearly adult selfie identity, arm-length camera distance and route direction. Motivate a local find with one gaze turn, prove it through one complete sensory action and restrained bodily reaction, then resume the original route while carrying the result instead of ending on an advertisement claim.

quick_start.input_format: same adult selfie subject and route + one gaze- or head-turn-motivated local discovery + one complete sniff or taste action + restrained bodily reaction without prescribed review copy + carry the result while resuming the original route
quick_start.recommended_input: An adult harbor botanist walks a sunset quay at stable arm length, notices a sea-herb tea cart with one gaze turn, smells and sips one transparent cup, pauses in restrained surprise, then continues along the same railing direction with the cup and the sun behind the same shoulder.
required_anchors: Keep one adult traveler, selfie distance, route direction and background parallax stable before the discovery.
Use a visible gaze or body turn to motivate the local discovery.
Preserve one readable bodily reaction without depending on exact dialogue.
Resume the same route while carrying a changed state or takeaway object.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Preserve one clearly adult selfie identity, arm-length camera distance and route direction. Motivate a local find with one gaze turn, prove it through one complete sensory action and restrained bodily reaction, then resume the original route while carrying the result instead of ending on an advertisement claim.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Maintain one original adult traveler in a plausible handheld selfie relationship with continuous route direction, face scale and background parallax. Let one visible gaze or head turn motivate a local discovery within the same environment. Show the acquired object clearly, complete exactly one use or taste action and hold an unforced bodily reaction long enough to read without prescribed speech. Return the traveler to the same route carrying a changed state or takeaway object. The reusable mechanism is selfie-route continuity, gaze-motivated local discovery, sensory proof and resumed travel—not the source woman, face, clothing, city, bakery, pastry, street, dialogue, gestures, camera path, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Keep one adult traveler, selfie distance, route direction and background parallax stable before the discovery.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unmotivated location jump makes the clip feel assembled rather than lived.

invariants.rule: Use a visible gaze or body turn to motivate the local discovery.
invariants.purpose: Connects environment attention to the next subject.
invariants.ablation_failure: A detached storefront insert has no traveler-driven cause.

invariants.rule: Show the acquired object and complete exactly one use or taste action.
invariants.purpose: Provides direct experience proof instead of promotional assertion.
invariants.ablation_failure: Holding an object without using it leaves the discovery unresolved.

invariants.rule: Preserve one readable bodily reaction without depending on exact dialogue.
invariants.purpose: Makes the sensory result observable and evidence-backed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Prescribed words or exaggerated reaction can replace rather than prove the experience.

invariants.rule: Resume the same route while carrying a changed state or takeaway object.
invariants.purpose: Closes the detour and returns the traveler to forward motion.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending at the product close-up loses the travel structure.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source adult woman, face, body, hair, clothing, jewelry, expressions and exact gestures
the source Dearborn street, storefronts, cars, pedestrians, bakery display and location identity
the source triangular pastry, cup or phone, bite, chewing performance and reaction timing
the source iPhone selfie path, golden-hour composition, exact speech implication and 30-second rhythm
the source creator identity, Seedance 2.5 claim, watermark, overlay and branding
